commands.live-launcher.py:
import hashlib,json,subprocess,time,sys
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
art=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
connection=json.loads((art/'connection.json').read_text())
edition=sys.argv[1]
def guest(script):
 guard='set -e\ntest "$(cat /sys/class/dmi/id/product_name)" = "MTTKDE release capture"\nexport XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-1 DISPLAY=:0 XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=KDE QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=kde\ncd ~/release-capture/source\n'
 return subprocess.check_output(connection['ssh']+['bash -s'],input=guard+script,text=True)
def states():
 return json.loads(guest("PYTHONPATH=src/scripts python3 - <<'PY'\nfrom release_capture_guest import windows\nimport json\nprint(json.dumps(windows()))\nPY\n"))
def qmp(*args):
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(art/'input.py'),json.dumps(args)],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
def panel():
 s=[w['geometry'] for w in states() if w['appletPopup'] and not w['hidden']]
 p=next(w for w in s if w['height']>250)
 for c in s:
  if c['height']<200: assert abs(c['width']/p['width']-.617)<.01,(p,c)
 return p
def menu(preset):
 s=states()
 p=next(w['geometry'] for w in s if w['appletPopup'] and not w['hidden'] and ((w['geometry']['height']<200)==(preset==2)))
 x=p['x']+p['width']-(54 if preset==2 else 30)
 y=p['y']+(p['height']/2 if preset==2 else 28)
 qmp('click',round(2*x),round(2*y));time.sleep(.3)
 return next(w['geometry'] for w in states() if w['resourceClass']=='org.kde.plasmashell' and w['type']==0 and w['geometry']['width']<250 and not w['hidden'])
def choose(m,preset):
 qmp('click',round((m['x']+80)*2),round((m['y']+(124 if preset==1 else 148))*2));time.sleep(.4)
 p=panel();assert abs(p['width']-(636 if preset==1 else 1028))<=1,p
 result.append({'action':'menu-select','preset':preset,'kwin_panel':p})
def capture(name):
 guest('spectacle -b -n -f -o ~/launcher-frame.png >/dev/null 2>&1\n')
 p=art/name
 subprocess.run(connection['scp']+['tester@127.0.0.1:/home/tester/launcher-frame.png',str(p)],check=True)
 return p
result=[]
guest("PYTHONPATH=src/scripts python3 - <<'PY'\nfrom release_capture_guest import windows\nwindows('workspace.windowList().filter(w=>w.windowType===0 && String(w.resourceClass)!==\"org.kde.plasmashell\").forEach(w=>w.closeWindow());')\nPY\n")
# Start from the installed preset 2 left open by launcher_presets.py.
for mode in ('light','dark'):
 guest('~/.local/bin/mac-tahoe-theme-switch '+mode+'\n')
 time.sleep(.5)
 if not any(w['appletPopup'] and not w['hidden'] for w in states()):
  guest('qdbus6 org.kde.plasmashell /PlasmaShell org.kde.PlasmaShell.activateLauncherMenu\n');time.sleep(.5)
 for preset in (2,1):
  m=menu(preset)
  qmp('move',round((m['x']+50)*2),round((m['y']+67)*2));time.sleep(.25)
  hovered=capture(f'launcher-{edition}-preset{preset}-{mode}-hover.png')
  rgb=Image.open(hovered).convert('RGB').getpixel((round((m['x']+12)*2),round((m['y']+67)*2)))
  assert rgb[2]>180 and rgb[0]<40 and rgb[1]>90,(m,rgb)
  qmp('move',3400,1900);time.sleep(.25)
  frame=capture(f'launcher-{edition}-preset{preset}-{mode}.png')
  outside=Image.open(frame).convert('RGB').getpixel((round((m['x']+12)*2),round((m['y']+67)*2)))
  assert not(outside[2]>180 and outside[0]<40 and outside[1]>90),(m,outside)
  result.append({'case':f'{mode}-preset{preset}','kwin_menu':m,'kwin_panel':panel(),'hover_pixel':rgb,'outside_pixel':outside,'frame':frame.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(frame.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
  choose(m,1 if preset==2 else 2)
(art/f'launcher-{edition}-live.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
